description: Frontend integration: add distance input fields to viewer.html, call the backend API on change, update X/Z hidden inputs and 3D scene. Also handle reverse: when objects are dragged, call /api/parcel/distance to update distance fields.
steps: In frontend/viewer.html, add a new panel-section BEFORE the existing 'Parametry budynku' section titled 'Pozycjonowanie wzgledem granic'. This section contains: (a) two number inputs for building: 'odl-budynek-poludnie' (default 5) and 'odl-budynek-wschod' (default 6), (b) two number inputs for panels: 'odl-panele-poludnie' (default 31) and 'odl-panele-wschod' (default 1), (c) a read-only display showing distance between NE corner of building and SW corner of panels (id='odl-naroznik-info'), (d) a button 'Przelicz pozycje' that triggers API calls

Add an inline <script> block (following the existing pattern in viewer.html with non-module scripts) that: (a) on 'Przelicz pozycje' click OR on input change of distance fields, calls POST /api/parcel/position twice (once for building, once for panels) with hardcoded vertices W0-W4 and current dimensions/azimuth from the form, (b) sets the returned x,z values into bud-x, bud-z, panel-pos-x, panel-pos-z fields, (c) dispatches 'input' event on those fields to trigger 3D scene movement, (d) computes and displays NE corner building to SW corner panels distance

Handle reverse direction: listen to 'budynekMoved' and 'paneleMoved' events. When fired, call POST /api/parcel/distance with the new position and update the distance input fields (without triggering a re-position loop - use a flag like __aktualizacjaOdleglosciWToku)
The hardcoded parcel vertices are: [[-20.8, 16.5], [9.7, 21.4], [15.2, -13.2], [12.7, -15.6], [-16.8, -9.2]] - store as a JS constant

Ensure the existing bud-x/bud-z and panel-pos-x/panel-pos-z fields remain visible but labeled as 'obliczone automatycznie' (computed automatically) and still work as before if user edits them directly
acceptance_criteria: Distance input fields appear in the viewer sidebar before the building parameters section
Changing distance values triggers API call and updates X/Z position fields
Dragging objects in 3D updates distance fields via reverse API call
NE-SW corner distance is displayed and updates on any position change
All existing 413+ tests still pass (no backend regression)
Default values (building 5m/6m, panels 31m/1m) produce reasonable positions on page load
verification: Start server, open browser, verify distance fields appear and produce correct positions
findings: Implementation complete. The /api/parcel/distance endpoint does not require typ_obiektu parameter - it always computes wall/edge distance regardless of object type. Hardcoded panel dimensions in frontend: 5.5m x 4.0m. NE-SW corner distance calculation uses rotated half-dimensions. Auto-przelicz runs 500ms after page load to allow localStorage to restore first. All 443 backend tests pass.
